pages.title: Charge
pages.text:
Mana provider, expected charge amount (double), mana receiver -> Charge ->

Order is strict.

[Provider Types]
• Slot Reference: Consumes mana from items (see next page) or mana bottles.
• Coordinate (Vec3): Draws from mana pedestal or spell machine at that location.
• Player: Draws from caster's own mana (self only).

[Receiver Types]
• Player: Replenishes player's mana.
• Coordinate: Replenishes machine/pedestal mana at that location.
• Slot Reference: Replenishes scroll or mana bottle mana.

[Consumable List]
• Amethyst Shard / Lapis Lazuli: Max 25 mana per use.
• Amethyst Block: Max 100 mana per use.
• Lapis Lazuli Block: Max 225 mana per use.

[Notes]
• Actual charge = min(expected value, source available amount, target remaining capacity).
• Mana cost: None.
